name: FlowyTeam
description:
FlowyTeam is a team productivity and performance management platform used by organizations across 140+ countries. This connector links your FlowyTeam workspace to Claude so you can manage work in natural language.

You can list, create, and update tasks and projects, track OKR objectives, key results, and performance cycles, view and manage employee records, and log attendance with clock in and out. It exposes 31 tools across these modules.

Every action runs against your live workspace and respects your existing role and permissions. Read tools fetch data, write tools change it, and tools that overwrite or delete existing records are labelled so Claude can ask you to confirm before running them.

Authentication uses OAuth 2.0. You authorize once, and no API token is copied. A free personal tier is available.

_published_faq.name: How do I add FlowyTeam to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add FlowyTeam to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://flowyteam.com/api/mcp/cloud/rpc. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the FlowyTeam MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: FlowyTeam lists 31 MCP tools, including flowyteam_clock_in, flowyteam_clock_out, flowyteam_create_employee, flowyteam_create_key_result, flowyteam_create_objective, flowyteam_create_performance_cycle, flowyteam_create_project, flowyteam_create_task, flowyteam_delete_objective, flowyteam_delete_project, flowyteam_delete_task, and flowyteam_get_attendance.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to FlowyTeam?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to FlowyTeam in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
FlowyTeam requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
FlowyTeam is developed by FlowyTeam. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
